name: DeleteRecordCustomer
label: Delete Record
description: Deletes a record in SAP Cloud for Customer.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID from SAP C4C App Management.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret from SAP C4C App Management.

fields.name: Subdomain
fields.label: Subdomain
fields.description: Your SAP C4C subdomain (e.g., 'mycompany' in mycompany.crm.ondemand.com).

fields.name: EntitySetName
fields.label: Entity Set Name
fields.description: The name of the OData entity set (e.g., 'SalesOrder').

fields.name: KeyValue
fields.label: Key Value
fields.description: The key value of the record to delete (e.g., 'SO0000000001').

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The response from the C4C server after deletion.
